prompt: Create a polished desktop UI screenshot comp for the Courrier email client, 16:10 landscape, actual Inbox working screen, not a poster or photograph. This is the alternate visual direction La table de tri: a calm personal sorting bench where email feels like a small set of clear, handled work items. Structure: compact left rail for only Boîte de réception, Feed, Paper, Réponse plus tard, Mis de côté, Brouillons, Corbeille; central message list with 5 distinct rows; broad reading pane for the selected message; small top bar with Courrier identity at upper left and account menu at upper right; no top search box. The selected email must read as an email, with sender, subject, paragraphs and concise reply / later / set aside / more actions at the bottom. Use a warm ivory paper ground, graphite ink, restrained brick red and muted brass; layered but mostly flat paper slips, precise margins, one small alignment mark, inviting editorial typography. Keep practical density and generous breathing room. Do not make a physical desk photo, envelopes, stamps, handwritten lettering, mailboxes, telephone or any imagined app sections, folders, attachment widgets, counters, charts or tools. Use simple generic French demo content, no facts or counts.
